analysis.primaryGoal: Drive orders over 200 kr. to clear limited stock of Mystery Boxes as part of 73rd anniversary event.
analysis.audience: Existing and potential Westpack webshop customers, Danish-speaking (B2B or B2C).
analysis.offer: Free Mystery Box with orders over 200 kr.; select boxes contain a 20% discount code.

visualStyle.imageStyle: Photo of staff in front of HQ, playful graphic overlay (boxes, question marks, starburst)

copyStyle.urgency: High (language: 'nu eller aldrig', very limited availability, event nearly over)

reusablePatterns: Anniversary or milestone as campaign anchor
Mystery gift mechanic to drive excitement
Scarcity language ('last chance', 'few left') to create urgency
Photo of staff/team to humanize and build trust
Stylized festive bunting as a visual divider
Hero graphic overlay for campaign emphasis
Clear, single large CTA positioned after offer explanation
Surprise element with possible added value (random bonus/discount in some boxes)
Legal disclaimer box for campaign details and terms
risks: Scarcity/urgency could disappoint if perceived as disingenuous
Surprise content (mystery) may not appeal to all segments
Strict legal disclosure needed for selective rewards (discount codes in some boxes only)

confidence.notes: All core copy, offer details, and CTA visible and readable. Small print and legal text included. Subject line and preheader not visible.
